id: \bBrawly uses Fighting type Pokémon. They are weak against the Flying and Psychic types.
en: \bBrawly uses Fighting type Pokémon. They are weak against the Flying and Psychic types.
it: \bRudi usa Pokémon di tipo Lotta. Sono deboli contro i tipi Volante e Psico.

id: \bThey are strong against Normal, Ice, Dark, Rock, and Steel. They are resistant to Bug, Dark, and Rock.
en: \bThey are strong against Normal, Ice, Dark, Rock, and Steel. They are resistant to Bug, Dark, and Rock.
it: \bSono superefficaci contro Normale, Ghiaccio, Buio, Roccia e Acciaio. Resistono a Coleottero, Buio e Roccia.

id: \bBrawly: I hope you're ready. My Pokémon have trained aganist the waves for years. This won't be an easy victory.
en: \bBrawly: I hope you're ready. My Pokémon have trained aganist the waves for years. This won't be an easy victory.
it: \bRudi: Spero tu sia pronto. I miei Pokémon si sono allenati contro le onde per anni. Non sarà una vittoria facile.

id: \bBrawly: A fight in here isn't enough for the full thrill. Meet me at Route 106.
en: \bBrawly: A fight in here isn't enough for the full thrill.  Meet me at Route 106.
it: \bRudi: Una lotta qui dentro non basta per godersi tutto il brivido. Raggiungimi al Percorso 106.

id: \bBrawly: Be sure to go with the flow when you get the chance.
en: \bBrawly: Be sure to go with the flow when you get the chance.
it: \bRudi: Ricordati di seguire la corrente quando ne hai l'occasione.
\rRudi non perderà mai contro di te.
